fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can call Dowd Heat and Air at (918) 437-3721, email abigail@dowdheatandair.com, or leave your name and email here and the team will follow up.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency HVAC service?
faqs.a: Dowd offers same-day repair across the Tulsa metro during business hours (Mon-Fri 8am-7pm, Sat 8am-5pm), and no-heat or no-cool breakdowns go to the front of the line. If your system fails outside those hours, call (918) 437-3721 and you'll be first on the schedule when they open.

faqs.q: What brands do you install and service?
faqs.a: All major brands, including Rheem, Carrier, Trane, Bryant, Goodman and Lennox - Dowd's technicians are trained and certified across multiple manufacturers.
Yes - Dowd partners with Upgrade to offer flexible financing on new systems, so you don't have to pay the full amount upfront. Ask about available plans when you get your quote.

pricing.summary: Repair prices aren't published on the Dowd website - Dowd quotes upfront before any work starts, and you approve the price first. Written estimates are provided on replacements, and qualifying PSO heat-pump rebates ($600, $1,000 or $1,400 depending on efficiency) come straight off the invoice. Financing is available through Upgrade.
